act_title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

quests.title: Variations on Belyi and Chernyi: Schedule

dialogue.t: Rehearsal is about to start. You can sit on the floor and watch if you want.
Dance rehearsals involve lots of repetitive practice, though, so it might not be that entertaining. Feel free to leave if you get bored.
Okay! Don't worry about us. We'll play it by ear!
Wow. She got into the zone the minute she walked through that door. Her whole aura seems different.

dialogue.sit: Maybe she also needs to be a role model for the other dancers.

dialogue.t: Yeah, let's head in. Hopefully, the rehearsal goes smoothly.
